definition: In this packet, abandonment means leaving an older person without needed care or support, typically by family members or institutional staff. It is presented as one form of elder abuse.

provenance.scope: Source record D004552; pinned source text

reasons: The packet does not define abandonment as “leaving an older person without needed care or support”; it only lists “abandonment” as one of several forms of elder abuse alongside maltreatment and exploitation without providing a separate meaning.

While the packet supports that elder abuse (including abandonment) is generally by “family members or … institutional personnel,” the definition’s specific phrasing about leaving without needed care/support is not directly supported by the provided packet text.
Adds the unsupported detail that abandonment means leaving an older person without needed care or support; the packet only says ‘abandonment of the older person’ as part of elder abuse.

The definition narrows the agents to family members or institutional staff, while the packet says ‘generally by family members or by institutional personnel’ and does not require that framing as part of the definition.
